notes.title: Update 1.1.40 – Smarter AI, sharper runs and better goalies
notes.content:
[list]
[*] 🏃‍♂️ We’ve unlocked the wings! The AI now makes spectacular runs down the flanks. Get ready for one-touch plays and crosses begging to be finished.
[*] 🧤 Goalkeepers are better positioned: We’ve refined their placement under the posts so they react faster and stay in the right spot.
[*] 🎈 The ball’s got new moves too: We’ve tweaked the physics when receiving aerial passes to make it feel more natural and realistic.
[*] 🎮 Fine-tuning on player switching: The new selection system now picks the best possible player even during quick passing situations.
[*] 🐞 And of course, a few small bugs squashed. Thanks for all your feedback — it keeps the game improving match after match!

[*] 🎯 Improved auto-pass system: both AI and manual passes (with button A) are now more accurate and better aimed.

notes.title: Title: 🧠 Smarter AI, smoother gameplay, and sliding tackles with attitude!
notes.content:
[list]
[*] ⚽ AI strikers are more creative: They now make smarter runs and might even raise their hand to ask for the ball. Time to feed them that perfect assist!
[*] ✋ Online pass calls: Raise your hand to ask for the ball during online matches. Other players will see it, and if an AI has the ball, it’ll try to pass it to you.
[*] 💥 Better sliding tackles: The ball now reacts more realistically, and refs are more lenient — if you get the ball first, it’s fair play even if you clip your opponent.
[*] 🧲 Standard control fix: Removed unfair ball losses caused by edge-case collisions. Smooth as butter.
[*] 🔁 Improved auto-possession: When playing with auto-possession enabled, you’ll now take control of your teammate earlier after passing to them.
[*] 🛠️ Custom team fix: Solved an issue when recovering corrupted edited teams. Thanks to Hussein for the help!

notes.title: Update 1.1.33 - New Hybrid Control Mode + Online Fixes

🌐 Also fixed a critical online bug that could cause the match to break in specific situations. Online play should now be smoother and more stable.
